desc:
Recommended for mid-to-high performance devices.

Formula Legacy is a fast-driving F1 racing game, Race on amazing tracks with people from all over the world. Choose from many different vehicles, sharpen your skills, and achieve the quickest lap times. experience real-world driving, multiplayer racing, and edge-of-your-seat moments in each track. Are you ready to leave your Legacy?

NOT AFFILIATED WITH THE FORMULA ONE GROUP
